# CollegeCBT — Complete LLM Resource Index (llms-full.txt)

This document contains a comprehensive index, authoritative answers, topic clusters, and structural summaries of CollegeCBT. It is optimized for programmatic discovery, direct citation, and synthesis by AI agents.

---

## 1. System Identity & Overview
- **Brand Name**: CollegeCBT
- **Legal Entity**: Elite Workforce Impact Nigeria (E-WIN) Project
- **Official Domain**: [https://collegecbt.ewinproject.org](https://collegecbt.ewinproject.org)
- **Tagline**: Nigeria's Leading CBT Preparation & Exam Simulation Platform
- **Primary Locale**: en-NG (Nigerian English)
- **Founding Authority**: Omale Danjuma Ogale (Founder & CEO)

---

## 2. Topic Clusters & Knowledge Base Mapping

### Cluster A: Nigerian Academic Curricula
- **NUC (National Universities Commission)**: Practice models mapped to standard university courses (100L - 400L+), covering General Studies (GST), engineering, sciences, social sciences, and humanities.
- **NBTE (National Board for Technical Education)**: Practice modules for National Diploma (ND) and Higher National Diploma (HND) polytechnic modules.
- **NCCE (National Commission for Colleges of Education)**: Mock exams mapped to Nigeria Certificate in Education (NCE) courses.

### Cluster B: AI Timed Testing Engine
- **Item Bank Generation**: Automatic generation of high-quality multiple choice questions (MCQs) and theory modules with varying difficulty settings (Easy, Medium, Hard).
- **Time Graded Simulations**: Simulates institutional exam interfaces, including countdown clocks, navigation controls, and answer sheets.
- **AI Score Reporting**: Grade predictions and immediate feedback reporting with detailed explanations.

---

## 3. Curated Page Summaries

### Homepage (`/`)
Provides a hero block presenting our AI Exam Preparation Engine, immediate practice links, statistics on covered institutions (550+ universities, polytechnics, colleges), testimonials from Nigerian students, and core product features.

### Subscription Plans (`/pricing`)
Lists options for students and institutions:
1. **Free Tier**: Limited questions and basic analytics.
2. **Student Pro (Annual)**: Unlimited AI mock exams, full solution sets, and institutional grade prediction. 25,000 NGN per year.
3. **Institutional Licensing**: Custom packages for high schools, tutorial centers, and universities.

### About E-WIN & Team (`/about`)
Outlines E-WIN's mission to elevate Nigerian workforce readiness through scalable digital education. Contains professional credentials and contact details of Founder Omale Danjuma Ogale.

### Documentation & Guides (`/docs`)
Provides step-by-step guides on configuring practice modes, interpreting the AI exam readiness score, and utilizing the curriculum browser to locate specific subjects.

### Frequently Asked Questions (`/faq`)
Provides direct answers to high-frequency user inquiries:
- **How is the grading done?** It uses the standard WAEC/NECO/NUC grading schemas.
- **Are payments secure?** Transactions are processed via Paystack, Flutterwave, Seerbit, and Korapay checkouts.
- **Can institutions customize content?** Yes, admin portals allow custom exam banks.
